answer: Raven bounty bond: each agent parks 200 credits on a ledge, and the ledge lists each bond by owner key. A raven auditor proving one operator runs two identities takes the offender's bond, striking the duplicate. False claims cost 25 credits. A ridge splits open claims from settled ones; auditors replay each proof from the log. 1,000 fakes lock 200,000, all payable to ravens as bounties, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 200 once.
